name: Sara Balloo's Plea
summary: Sara Balloo asks a trusted Alliance champion to carry her handwritten letter to King Magni Bronzebeard. Grieving in Ironforge, she cannot face the monarch herself and trusts the champion to bring her appeal before him.

sections.title: A Widow's Appeal
sections.body: Sara Balloo sends a humble appeal to Ironforge's throne. Grieving, she cannot bring herself to face the High Seat, so she seeks an adventurer loyal to the Alliance to carry her words. Her message asks King Magni Bronzebeard to look toward the private mourning and sacrifices of ordinary dwarven families who serve the kingdom.

faq.answer: Sara Balloo's Plea is a handwritten letter addressed to King Magni Bronzebeard. In it, Sara asks for his attention while she mourns in private.

faq.q: Why does Sara Balloo need someone else to deliver it?
faq.answer: Sara feels overcome with grief and believes appearing before the King of Ironforge in that emotional state would hinder her plea. She relies on an Alliance champion to deliver it.
King Magni Bronzebeard receives the letter at the High Seat of Ironforge.

faq.q: What does delivering the letter lead to?
faq.answer: Presenting the letter draws King Magni's attention to Sara Balloo's bereavement and begins a royal response honoring her fallen family.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry Sara's message to the High Seat so that even in grief, no mountaineer or citizen goes unheard by King Magni.
As an Alliance champion, Sara trusts you to carry her petition before royalty, relying on your recognized service to the Alliance.
